{'text': 'Apple嘅全新iPhone Duo已經正式開賣，如果你成功搶到一部（可能要等明年先有機會），我哋已經喺下面為大家整理咗一系列最靚嘅Duo手機殼。由Apple全新嘅TechWoven處理技術到Pitaka嘅芳綸纖維，等緊各路頂尖皮革品牌準備開接單，為佢哋最新嘅頭層皮保護殼做好準備。當然，呢啲之外仲有唔少極為平價嘅選擇，低至27美元（約210港元）就有，大家可以喺下面慢慢睇。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple’s new iPhone Duo has arrived and if you managed to secure one (before next year), we have collection of the best Duo cases waiting below. From Apple’s all-new TechWoven treatment and Pitaka’s aramid fiber, we are also seeing some of the best leather brands in the business ready to take orders for their latest full-grain covers. Those, of course, join some ultra-affordable models starting from $27 or less and you can scope them all out below.'}

{'text': 'Apple', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple'}

{'text': 'Apple配合佢嘅全新折疊機，一口氣推出咗兩款專為Duo設計嘅保護殼，配色完全對應——我真係好鍾意呢款採用TechWoven技術布料的支架款式。兩款當然都支援MagSafe，完美貼合Dode，現在已經開始發售（Amazon暫時缺貨，但你想買嘅話喺斷貨前仲有機會入手）。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple unleashed a pair of new purpose-built Duo cases along with its new foldable in matching colorways – I’m really loving this technical fabric TechWoven look in the kickstand form-factor. Both, of course, come MagSafe-ready, should fit the Duo perfectly, and are now available for purchase (they are temporarily out of stock on Amazon, but you can lock one in before they are gone for good).'}

{'text': 'Pitaka', 'paragraph_context': 'Pitaka'}

{'text': '呢啲保護殼採用「精密織造紋理同精緻3D塗層」，聲稱可以帶來「持久亮麗嘅顏色同自然舒適嘅握持手感」。拋光高邊框可以保護鏡頭凸位，配備完整MagSafe功能，加上「精密切割開孔」完美貼合按鍵同接口。', 'paragraph_context': 'These cases are made of “precision-woven texture and refined 3D coating” that is said to deliver “lasting color, and a naturally comfortable grip.” Polished raised bezels to protect the camera bump, full MagSafe action, and “precision-machined cutouts” to fit around the buttons and ports are in place here as well.'}
